testMappings.upstream: pressing e with no $EDITOR surfaces a notice instead of crashing
testMappings.assertion: A missing EDITOR value returns the exact notice before any process or terminal action.

testMappings.upstream: pressing e opens the editor at the current line, not the hunk start
testMappings.assertion: Two source-line steps launch at new line 2 and the next step launches at context line 3, rather than repeatedly using hunk line 1.

adaptations: Ratatui input dispatch records an owned ReviewEditorRequest; the terminal host performs the environment, path, suspend, and spawn operation after the event handler returns.
Source-line navigation is derived from rendered review row targets and collapses wrapped continuations and inline-note rows, so one j or k command advances one Hunk line-cursor stop.
